description:
Aether turns your iPhone into a sky you can paint.

Choose a landscape from a curated gallery, draw cloud silhouettes with a finger on a simple canvas, and a Metal volumetric renderer turns them into real three-dimensional clouds — lit by the real position of the sun and moon, at the place and hour you choose.

There is no complex 3D editor here. A handful of gestures and sliders, and a sky that answers to light.

PAINT
Draw silhouettes on a canvas; a volumetric raymarcher turns each stroke into a real three-dimensional cloud, accumulated in a density field. Adjust brush radius and softness as you go.

REAL LIGHT
The sun and a correctly phased moon are computed for the real place and instant. Move the hour slider — or let time advance on its own — and your clouds relight live, from warm dawn through white noon to lunar night.

A PHYSICAL SKY
An atmospheric sky (Rayleigh and Mie scattering) follows the sun. The moon shows its phase and earthshine; thousands of real stars from the Yale Bright Star Catalogue scintillate at night — all of it occluded by the clouds you paint.

FREE GAZE
Rotate the view with one finger, pinch to zoom — nothing erases. Paint in a new direction and a fresh cloud opens there, anchored in world space, so you can fill the whole sky around you.

THE SEA
On coastal landscapes, a ray-marched ocean stretches below the horizon — reflecting the sky, catching a glint of sun, and a path of moonlight at night.

KEEP A SKY
Every sky saves to a self-contained file. Reopen it any time and the exact image is recomputed. No account, nothing to expire.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Aether collects no data. No account, no server, no ads, no trackers. Location, if you allow it, is used only on your device to orient the sky — it never leaves the phone.

A native Swift and SwiftUI app, rendered by a Metal volumetric pipeline. Requires iOS 17 or later.
promotionalText: Paint cloud silhouettes; a Metal volumetric engine lights them with the real sun and moon at the place and hour you choose. Contemplative, slow, satisfying.
